original_metadata.name: 基线评估
original_metadata.description: 仅根据调用前上下文中已有的证据，评估用户相对于明确目标的当前能力基线。
preconditions: 用户或上游流程需要基于已有证据判断相对于某一目标的当前起点
postconditions: 通过 ReturnSkillResult 报告 success、insufficient_input 或 error

compiled_metadata.summary: Assesses a target-relative capability baseline using only evidence already present at invocation time.
trigger_examples: Assess my current baseline for becoming a backend engineer using what you already know about me.
Based on the profile and prior tool results in this conversation, assess my current product management baseline.
Evaluate my present SQL capability for this analytics role from the evidence already available.
negative_trigger_examples: Interview me to find out my current level.
Find my profile and collect evidence about my skills.
Create a learning plan for backend engineering.
